slc_note: Landsat 7's scan line corrector failed on 31 May 2003. Every later ETM+ image has wedge-shaped stripes with no data (about 22 % of a full scene), narrow near the centre line of the swath and widening toward its edges.
rule: November Landsat 7 ETM+ scenes (Collection 2 Tier 1) on WRS-2 160/043, 2003-2012; the box inside the scene footprint (stripes allowed); B8 not saturated; in-box cloud/dilated cloud/shadow (QA_PIXEL bits 1-4) <= 1.0 % of the pixels with data; B8 texture >= 0.5 x the median of the clear covering November ETM+ scenes (0.0698); not rejected by eye (visual_reject); closest to 10 November.
